sn35.72:1.2: The first two paragraphs as in the preceding sutta.
sn35.72:3.2: do you regard the eye thus: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self’?”
sn35.72:5.1: “Good, bhikkhu! And here, bhikkhu, you should clearly see the eye as it really is with correct wisdom thus: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’
sn35.72:5.2: Thus this first base for contact will be abandoned by you for no future renewed existence.
sn35.72:8.1: Thus this second base for contact will be abandoned by you for no future renewed existence….
sn35.72:9.1: “Do you regard the mind thus: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self’?”
sn35.72:11.1: “Good, bhikkhu! And here, bhikkhu, you should clearly see the mind as it really is with correct wisdom thus: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’
sn35.72:11.2: Thus this sixth base for contact will be abandoned by you for no future renewed existence.”
